verdict.rationale: Docs show Radar surfaces a 'network of related payments' across customer ID, IP, or card number (docs-12) and ingests card-issuer signals via Early Fraud Warnings (docs-9), implying some cross-account risk signal, and docs-6 describes 'out-of-the-box' pre-trained fraud detection. However, none of the evidence explicitly states the model is trained on or scores against Stripe's full cross-merchant network of thousands of businesses. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the network-wide ML training/scoring claim, and independent confirmation that cross-merchant signals (not just same-business history) drive individual risk scores.
